notices.notDurable: This browser can't keep a spare copy of your changes. Keep this tab open until they are saved.
notices.rejectedBody: These changes were not saved. Fix the value, or try them again.

general.intro: Defaults for your chats. Every change is saved as you make it.
general.systemPromptHint: Sent at the start of every chat. Up to 20,000 characters.
general.includeDate: Put today’s date in the system prompt
general.includeDateHint: Lets the model answer questions about today.
general.titleModelNone: Use the model of the chat
general.background: Keep writing when I close the tab
general.backgroundHint: The answer is waiting for you when you come back.
general.temperatureHint: From 0 to 2. Leave empty to use each model's own default.
general.maxOutputHint: Leave empty for no limit from NeoText.
general.contextStrategy: When a chat gets too long

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.intro: Changes show up right away, and follow you to other browsers.
appearance.sample: Settings change the page as you pick them. This paragraph uses your reading font and text size, so you can judge how a long answer will feel to read.

sidebar.intro: Choose what the sidebar shows and where it sits.

snippets.intro: Save text you reuse. Type / at the start of a line in the message box to pick one. Write {{example}} where you want to fill in a blank when you use it.
snippets.triggerHint: What you type after / to find it. Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.
snippets.triggerInvalid: Use 1 to 32 lowercase letters, numbers or dashes, without spaces.
snippets.triggerTaken: This trigger is already used by another snippet. Pick a different one.
snippets.title: Title
snippets.titleTooLong: The title can be up to 200 characters. Shorten it and try again.
snippets.bodyTooLong: The text can be up to 20,000 characters. Shorten it and try again.

shortcuts.intro: Change the keys for the things you do most. Shortcuts that use Ctrl or Cmd also work while you are typing.
shortcuts.listening: Press the new keys, or Escape to cancel.
shortcuts.taken: {{combo}} is already used by “{{action}}”. Press other keys, or change that one first.
shortcuts.needsModifier: Include Ctrl, Alt or Cmd so the shortcut does not get in the way of typing.
shortcuts.reserved: That key is used for editing text. Pick another.

providers.title: Providers
providers.intro: Where your models come from. API keys stay on the server and are never shown again after you save them.
providers.empty: No provider yet. Add one to start chatting.
providers.loadFailed: Providers could not load. Check your connection and try again.
providers.share: Share with everyone on this NeoText
providers.shareHint: Everyone here can use it without seeing the key. Only admins can change it.
providers.name: Name
providers.baseUrlRequired: Enter the base URL of the endpoint, for example https://example.com/v1.
providers.keyKeepHint: Leave empty to keep the saved key.
providers.keyWillBeRemoved: The key will be removed when you save.
providers.headersHint: One per line, written as Name: value.
providers.headersKeepHint: One per line, written as Name: value. Saved headers are not shown. Type here only to replace them.
providers.headersInvalid: Write each header as Name: value, one per line.
providers.modelsHint: One per line. For endpoints that can't list their own models.
providers.enabledHint: Turn off to stop sending new messages to it. Your chats stay.
providers.testHint: Tests the saved settings. Save your changes first to test them.
providers.deleteBody: Your chats stay. New messages can't use this provider.
providers.searchIntro: Web search for models outside OpenRouter. Choose one as the search backend in Tools.
providers.searchBaseUrlHint: The address the service answers on. For SearXNG, your own instance.
providers.searxngUrlRequired: Enter the address of your SearXNG instance, for example http://localhost:8080.
providers.keyRequired: Paste the API key for this service.

mcp.intro: Tool servers give models extra abilities, like reading your calendar. Tools ask before running unless you allow them.
mcp.empty: No tool server yet. Add one to give models more abilities.
mcp.loadFailed: Tool servers could not load. Check your connection and try again.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.nameHint: Up to 40 characters. Each server needs its own name.
mcp.nameRequired: Give the tool server a name.
mcp.urlHint: The address of the MCP server, starting with http:// or https://.
mcp.urlInvalid: Enter a full address that starts with http:// or https://.
mcp.headersHint: Some servers need a header such as Authorization to let you in.
mcp.headersReplaceHint: Fill in the rows to replace the saved headers. Leave them empty to keep them.
mcp.headersSaved: Headers saved. Their values are not shown.
mcp.headersWillGo: The saved headers will be removed when you save.
mcp.headerNameInvalid: Header names use letters, digits and these symbols only: ! # $ % & ' * + - . ^ _ ` | ~
mcp.headerValueInvalid: Header values cannot contain line breaks.
mcp.testNone: Connected, but the server lists no tools.
mcp.testFailed: The test failed. Check the address and try again.
mcp.deleteBody: Your chats stay. Models can't use this server's tools anymore.

models.title: Models
models.intro: Every model your providers offer. Star the ones you use most, hide the ones you don't, or correct details a provider gets wrong.
models.loadFailed: The model list could not load. Check your connection and try again.

override.description: Your values replace what the provider reports. Leave a field empty to use the catalog.

tools.intro: What the assistant can do besides writing: search the web, read pages and use tools from tool servers.
tools.webSearchIntro: The model decides when to search. Engine, mode and context size apply to models on OpenRouter. Other models search through your search backend.

price.auto: The model’s own search when it has one, else Exa

tools.oneToTen: Enter a whole number from 1 to 10.
tools.contextSizeHint: How much of each page the engine passes to the model.
tools.backendHint: For models outside OpenRouter. Add SearXNG, Brave or Tavily under Providers.
tools.toolsIntro: Choose which tools run on their own and which ask you first.

descriptions.fetch_url: Opens a link and reads the page’s text.
descriptions.web_search: Searches the web with your search backend.
descriptions.delegate_tasks: Lets the chat model split a big job into parallel tasks.
descriptions.search_knowledge: Lets a custom agent search the files you added to it.
descriptions.write_file: Creates or replaces a file of the chat’s web project, which runs in the preview.
descriptions.edit_file: Changes one part of a project file.
descriptions.delete_file: Removes a file from the chat’s web project.
descriptions.read_file: Reads a project file before changing it.

tools.loadFailed: Tools could not load. Check your connection and try again.
tools.maxStepsHint: Stops a long chain of tool calls in one answer.
tools.maxStepsRange: Enter a whole number from 1 to 20.
tools.servers: Tools from MCP servers appear in this list too.
tools.backendLoadFailed: Search providers could not load. Check your connection and try again.

data.title: Data
data.intro: Your settings are versioned, and your server keeps backups. Nothing here is lost silently.
data.recovered: Your saved settings couldn't be read, so defaults are in use. Restore one of the versions below to bring your settings back.
data.historyIntro: NeoText keeps your last 50 saved versions. Restoring one keeps the current settings in this list first, so you can undo it.
data.historyEmpty: No earlier versions yet. They appear here as you change settings.
data.historyFailed: The history could not load. Check your connection and try again.

reasons.migration: Kept before an update changed the format
reasons.quarantine: Kept because it couldn't be read

data.restoreBody: Your current settings are kept in the list first, so you can undo the restore.

trash.title: Trash
trash.intro: Deleted chats stay here for 30 days, then they are removed for good.
trash.failed: The trash could not load. Check your connection and try again.
trash.deleteBody: The chat and all its messages are removed and cannot be brought back.
trash.emptyBody_one: {{count}} chat will be removed for good. This cannot be undone.
trash.emptyBody_other: {{count}} chats will be removed for good. This cannot be undone.
trash.emptyBodyMin: At least {{count}} chats will be removed for good, maybe more. This cannot be undone.

data.backupsBody: Your server saves a full backup of the database every 6 hours, in the backups folder inside its data folder. It keeps the newest 10, plus 5 made before updates. Copy that folder somewhere safe now and then.

export.title: Export
export.intro: Download a copy of your data. An export only holds what is yours, never other people on this server.

explain.neotext: Your chats, folders, presets and settings, locked with a passphrase. Import it into NeoText later. Attached files and chats in the trash are not included.
explain.markdown: Readable text, one file per chat in a zip. Good for reading and archiving. Not encrypted. Attached files and chats in the trash are not included.
explain.json: Your chats, folders, presets and settings as unencrypted JSON, for scripts and other tools. Attached files and chats in the trash are not included.

export.passphraseHint: Keep it safe; it cannot be recovered.
export.includeKeysHint: Your API keys go into the encrypted file. Anyone with the file and passphrase can use them.
export.plainWarning: I understand this file is not encrypted. Anyone who gets it can read all my chats.
export.skippedAttachments_one: {{count}} attached file was not included. Open its chat to download it if you need it.
export.skippedAttachments_other: {{count}} attached files were not included. Open their chats to download them if you need them.

errors.export_too_large: Your chats are too large for one NeoText file. Export them as Markdown instead, or delete chats you no longer need and try again.

import.title: Import
import.intro: Bring in a NeoText file, or your chats from ChatGPT or Claude. Chats you already have are skipped.

how.neotext: A file exported from NeoText: chats, folders, presets, and settings if you choose. Afterwards, choose a model for the imported chats.
how.chatgpt: In ChatGPT, open Settings → Data controls → Export. Choose the zip from the email, or the conversations.json inside it.
how.claude: In Claude, open Settings → Privacy → Export data. Choose the zip from the email, or the conversations.json inside it.

import.passphraseMissing: Enter the passphrase this file was made with.
import.restoreSettingsHint: Your current settings are kept in the history above, so you can go back.
import.attachmentNotes_one: {{count}} attached file was not in the import. Its message shows the file name instead.
import.attachmentNotes_other: {{count}} attached files were not in the import. Their messages show the file names instead.

errors.wrong_passphrase: That passphrase does not open this file. Check it and try again.
errors.not_neotext: This is not a NeoText export file. Choose a .ntxb file exported from NeoText.
errors.passphrase_required: Enter the passphrase this file was made with.
errors.not_export: This is not a {{product}} export. Choose the conversations.json file, or the zip it came in.
errors.zip_without_entry: This zip has no conversations.json. Choose the zip exactly as {{product}} sent it.
errors.zip_duplicate_entry: This zip has more than one conversations.json, so it was not imported. Choose the zip exactly as {{product}} sent it.
errors.too_large: This file is too large to import. The limit is 200 MB.
errors.import_busy: Another import is running on this server. Try again when it has finished.
errors.import_running: Your last import is still running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.

failures.not_a_conversation: This entry is not a conversation.
failures.missing_messages: This conversation has no messages in the file.
failures.no_messages: This conversation has no messages to import.
failures.unreadable: This conversation could not be read.
failures.invalid_conversation: This conversation in the file is not valid.
failures.duplicate_conversation: This conversation appears twice in the file.
failures.invalid_message: A message in this conversation is not valid.
failures.broken_thread: The messages in this conversation do not form a valid thread.
failures.save_failed: This conversation could not be saved.
failures.invalid_folder: A folder in the file is not valid, so it was skipped.
failures.invalid_preset: A preset in the file is not valid, so it was skipped.
failures.invalid_provider: A provider in the file is not valid, so it was skipped.
failures.invalid_settings: The settings in this file are not valid, so they were not restored.

security.title: Security
security.intro: Your password, your recovery key, and what NeoText protects.
security.passwordHint: Other devices where you're signed in will be signed out.
security.recoveryBody: The recovery key is the only way back in if you forget your password. A new key stops the old one from working.
security.makeKeyBody: Your old key stops working as soon as the new one is made. You will see the new key once.
security.newKeyBody: Your old key no longer works. Keep this one somewhere safe, apart from your password.

sessions.title: Where you're signed in
sessions.intro: Devices that are signed in to your account. Sign out any you don't recognise.
sessions.loadFailed: Your devices could not load. Check your connection and try again.

security.encryptedBody: Someone who copies the database file cannot read these without your password or recovery key.

open.models: Model ids, provider names and addresses
open.flags: Pinned and archived flags, and the order of your chats

security.providerNote: Your model provider can read what you send to it.
security.operatorNote: Whoever runs this server can change its code, so use a server you trust.

about.title: About
about.intro: NeoText is an open-source chat app you host yourself.
about.licenseNote: Free to use, change and share.
about.whereBody: The README, the LICENSE and the security notes are in the NeoText folder on your server.

agents.intro: Agents are saved instructions the chat model can hand work to.
agents.clearSubagentModel: Use the chat model for sub-agents
agents.maxSubagentsInvalid: Use a whole number from 2 to 6.
agents.subagentsHelp: The chat model splits big jobs into parallel tasks only when it helps.
agents.empty: No agents yet. Create one for work you repeat, like reviewing frontend code.
agents.loadFailed: Agents could not load. Check your connection and try again.
agents.deleteBody: The agent is removed. Chats that already used it keep their answers.

editor.name: Name
editor.nameTooLong: Use 60 characters or fewer for the name.
editor.descriptionHint: One line that tells the chat model when this agent fits.
editor.instructionsRequired: Write the instructions the agent should follow.
editor.instructionsTooLong: Instructions can be up to 50,000 characters. Shorten them and try again.
editor.importTooBig: That file is larger than 200 KB. Pick a smaller .md or .txt file.
editor.importFailed: The file could not be read. Try another file.
editor.importCut: The file was longer than {{max}} characters, so the end was cut off.
editor.clearModel: Use the chat model for this agent
editor.autoDelegate: Let the chat model call this agent on its own
editor.invalid: Something in this agent is not valid. Check the fields and try again.

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.intro: Files the agent can search when it answers.
knowledge.saveFirst: Save the agent first to add files.
knowledge.drop: Drop files here or choose files
knowledge.failedFallback: The text could not be read from this file.
knowledge.loadFailed: The files could not load. Check your connection and try again.
knowledge.deleteBody: The agent will no longer search this file. This cannot be undone.

errors.type: This type is not supported. Use PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, CSV or HTML.
errors.tooBig: This file is larger than 10 MB. Split it or pick a smaller one.
errors.limit: An agent can hold {{max}} files. Delete one to add another.

errors.last_admin: NeoText needs at least one active admin. Make someone else an admin first.

users.intro: Everyone with an account on this NeoText. Their chats are not shown here.
users.loadFailed: Users could not load. Check your connection and try again.
users.name: Name
users.note: Disabling someone signs them out everywhere and stops their running answers. Costs are this calendar month in UTC; unknown costs are not counted.

reset.title: Reset password for {{name}}?
reset.body: {{name}} is signed out everywhere and gets a temporary password. Their chats stay readable.
reset.noEscrow: Password escrow is off, so this account can't be reset without losing its chats. {{name}} can reset it with their recovery key.
reset.notSignedInYet: {{name}} hasn't signed in since password escrow was turned on, so there is no key to reset with yet. Once they sign in, you can reset their password.
reset.doneBody: Give this to {{name}} privately. It is shown only now. They can change it in Settings, Security after signing in.
reset.label: Temporary password

invites.intro: An invite code lets one person create an account. Each code works once.
invites.loadFailed: Invites could not load. Check your connection and try again.
invites.codeBody: Send this code to the person you invite. It is shown only now.

audit.intro: What happened on this NeoText: sign-ins, account changes and data exports. Chats, keys and passwords are never recorded.
audit.loadFailed: Activity could not load. Check your connection and try again.

kinds.auth.recovery.used: Signed in with a recovery key
kinds.admin.user.updated: Changed an account's role or status
kinds.admin.quota.updated: Changed a user's budget on shared models
kinds.settings.quarantined: Set aside settings that could not be read

instance.intro: How this NeoText is used and who can join.
instance.loadFailed: Instance settings could not load. Check your connection and try again.

modes.personalHint: Just you, on your own server.
modes.communityHint: Several people, each with their own private chats.

instance.personalNoSignUps: A personal NeoText takes no sign-ups. Switch to community mode to open them.
instance.escrowHint: On: admins can reset passwords, and could read chats by using the server key. Off: only the password or recovery key opens a user's chats.
instance.escrowLater: Each person is covered from their next sign-in. Turning escrow off erases every stored key.

quota.title: Shared budget for {{name}}
quota.intro: The most {{name}} can spend on shared models, per UTC day and month. Their own providers are never limited.
quota.error: Enter an amount of 0 or more, or leave the box empty.
quota.following: No limit of their own, so the instance default applies.
quota.loadFailed: The budget could not load. Check your connection and try again.
quota.defaultIntro: What each member can spend on shared models unless they have a limit of their own. Costs that are unknown are not counted.
